record.label: Joint system redesign
record.summary: The joint-redesign design study is complete and independently audited. Its central measurement is the additive invariant: between the base and lambda-cubed hosts the corrected residual moved only +0.0293e-8 while the host improved 0.889e-8 and the correction's absolute removal shrank 0.918e-8 - host gains transfer approximately zero (measured slightly negative) to the corrected endpoint. Directions rejected on entailed evidence: shell-scale joint fitting and an observer redesigned for the harder X residual (both inherit the five-arm information cap). Selected: a fundamentally better host whose raw error reaches the invariant scale, first milestone raw at or below about 3e-8, candidate foundation the deep kink-carrier closure family, carrying over the conditional-repair budget discipline and the measurably real lambda-cubed shell. Audit caveats of record: a fully jointly TRAINED host-plus-observer is unexplored rather than closed, and the corrected-error-bounded-by-host-error mechanism is protocol-enforced through correction optionality, not operator-structural.
record.terminal_criterion: Solved: the audited study selects exactly one direction with exact evidence citations; every data-bearing arm requires its own frozen preregistration inside the successor.
